subtitle: 道頓堀から半径3.2km · ベジ・グルテンフリー
note: Restaurant guide for a 2-mile circle around Dotonbori, with gluten-free/vegan/mom-&-pop/ramen finds.

places.name: 金龍ラーメン 道頓堀店 (Kinryu Ramen Dotonbori)
places.neighborhood: Dotonbori 1-chōme, under the giant dragon on the canal side — 5 min from Namba Stn exit 14
places.cuisine: 24-hour Minami ramen under the giant dragon · pork-bone and chicken-feet tonkotsu · ramen or chashu ramen only (ramen ¥900) · free kimchi, garlic and garlic chives · tatami seating

noodles.notes: House-made noodles (listing); diners describe them as medium-thin with a slight curl and lower water content (2026).

ramen.signature_bowl: ラーメン (ramen) — ¥900 in October 2026; チャーシューメン also offered.
ramen.chashu: Two kinds, sliced and cubed, on the sweet side (one 2026 review).
ramen.pantheon: Dotonbori after midnight: a light pork-bone bowl under the giant dragon, made your own with free kimchi, garlic and garlic chives, carried to the tatami on a number tag.

richness: "The broth is pork bone-based but quite light"; another: "surprisingly light" (https://tabelog.com/en/osaka/A2701/A270202/27001495/dtlrvwlst/B536645572/); the listing itself calls it rich.
oiliness: "Surprisingly light even after finishing my meal"; "lacks richness, it has a sharp finish" (https://tabelog.com/en/osaka/A2701/A270202/27001495/dtlrvwlst/B536670125/).
clarity: "The broth was a light tonkotsu" — a pork-bone broth; no source says it is clear.
tare_strength: "The seasoning is also sharp"; another found it "on the milder side in terms of saltiness" (https://tabelog.com/en/osaka/A2701/A270202/27001495/dtlrvwlst/B409489189/).
noodle_firmness: "Medium-thin with a slight curl, cooked just right… a lower water content"; the listing calls them firm.
aroma_punch: "The smell of tonkotsu broth was strong"; free kimchi and garlic chives add spice (https://tabelog.com/en/osaka/A2701/A270202/27001495/dtlrvwlst/B536384620/).

places.address_ja: 〒542-0071 大阪府大阪市中央区道頓堀1-7-26

places.name: どうとんぼり神座 道頓堀店 (Dotonbori Kamukura)
places.neighborhood: Dotonbori 1-chōme (1-7-25), next to Kinryū Ramen — 5 min from Namba Stn
places.cuisine: Dotonbori-born light ramen chain · secret broth with crunchy napa cabbage and fine-sliced pork · "delicious ramen" ¥850 · small chashu and soft-egg ramen ¥1,270 · seasonal hot-and-sour noodles · open 22 h

noodles.notes: Soft noodles "with a texture similar to udon" (October 2026); another diner found them "nothing special".

ramen.signature_bowl: おいしいラーメン (delicious ramen) — ¥850 in October 2026; 小チャーシュー煮玉子ラーメン ¥1,270 (September 2026).
ramen.chashu: Thin-sliced pork in the bowl; small chashu on the popular version.
ramen.pantheon: Dotonbori's gentle bowl: a light, faintly sweet secret broth buried under crunchy napa cabbage and thin pork, served nearly round the clock and loved precisely for not being heavy.

richness: "The ramen is loaded with vegetables, and the broth is light and easy to drink"; "light, sweet flavor" (https://tabelog.com/en/osaka/A2701/A270202/27001562/dtlrvwlst/B536755192/).
oiliness: "An easy-to-eat type of ramen without heaviness."
clarity: No source describes the broth's look; placed mid-scale from repeated "light and easy to drink" descriptions.
tare_strength: "I found the saltiness of the broth to be quite strong"; others call it light and sweet (https://tabelog.com/en/osaka/A2701/A270202/27001562/dtlrvwlst/B536755192/).
noodle_firmness: "The noodles have a texture similar to udon"; "The noodles were nothing special" (https://tabelog.com/en/osaka/A2701/A270202/27001562/dtlrvwlst/B536755192/).
aroma_punch: "A healthy ramen with a gentle flavor."

places.address_ja: 〒542-0071 大阪府大阪市中央区道頓堀1-7-25

places.name: 金久右衛門 道頓堀店 (Kinkuemon Dotonbori)
places.neighborhood: Dotonbori 1-chōme (1-4-17), a little off the main strip next to Kinryū — 5 min from Namba Stn
places.cuisine: Osaka Black shoyu ramen · jet-black soy broth with chicken stock and seafood umami · King Shoyu and clear Kinjou Shoyu · thin or thick noodles · extra noodles · ¥1,000–1,200 · open through the night

noodles.notes: Choice of thin (most recommended; straight and chewy) or thick noodles; firmness can be ordered (2026).

ramen.chashu: Chashu with menma, green onion and a seasoned soft egg.
ramen.pantheon: Minami's night-owl shoyu: a glossy jet-black soy broth with chicken stock and a seafood edge, buttery chicken fat, faintly bitter soy, and thin straight noodles that drink it all in.

richness: "Rich flavor with seafood umami… the broth has a delightful balance of soy sauce and seafood flavors, providing a refreshing taste."
oiliness: "The chicken fat has a rich buttery aroma."
clarity: "A nice glossy black appearance" — a dark shoyu chintan; the Kinjou Shoyu is "the clear broth" (https://tabelog.com/en/osaka/A2701/A270202/27062271/dtlrvwlst/B427234572/).
tare_strength: "The broth has a slightly bitter soy sauce flavor"; "a refreshing depth of soy sauce flavor and a hint of saltiness that was quite addictive" (https://tabelog.com/en/osaka/A2701/A270202/27062271/dtlrvwlst/B536118649/).
noodle_firmness: "Thin noodles and a firm texture… The straight, chewy thin noodles."
aroma_punch: "The aroma of the rich black soy sauce combined with seafood in the jet-black broth was absolutely delightful!"

places.address_ja: 〒542-0071 大阪府大阪市中央区道頓堀1-4-17

places.name: らぁ麺 はやし田 道頓堀店 (Ramen Hayashida Dotonbori)
places.neighborhood: Dotonbori Kankō Bldg B1F, right under the Glico sign by Ebisubashi — 3 min from Namba Stn
places.cuisine: Tokyo Shinjuku shoyu ramen brand under the Glico sign · duck and Daisen-chicken clear shoyu (¥900; special ¥1,200) · chicken paitan · tsukemen · seasonal yuzu cold ramen · TKG and oyakodon sides

noodles.notes: Firm, thin noodles made with whole-wheat flour (October 2026); the cold ramen uses flat medium-thick noodles.

ramen.signature_bowl: 醤油らぁ麺 (shoyu ramen) — ¥900 (July 2026); 特製醤油らぁ麺 ¥1,200 (October 2026).
ramen.chashu: Pork shoulder and chicken breast; rare chashu on the cold ramen.
ramen.pantheon: A Shinjuku queue-shop under the Glico running man: clear duck and Daisen-chicken shoyu on firm thin whole-wheat noodles, served in minutes when the famous names next door are lined up.

richness: "The ramen was light and easy to enjoy."
oiliness: "Light and easy to enjoy" — no source mentions an oil layer.
tare_strength: "The broth was rich with the flavors of duck and Daisendori chicken, making it delicious enough to drink on its own."
noodle_firmness: "Firm, thin noodles made with whole wheat flour."
aroma_punch: "I love the soup made with duck and Daisendori chicken"; the cold version adds yuzu (https://tabelog.com/en/osaka/A2701/A270202/27128015/dtlrvwlst/B534474065/).

places.address_ja: 〒542-0071 大阪府大阪市中央区道頓堀1-10-1 道頓堀観光ビル B1F

places.name: ラー麺ずんどう屋 道頓堀店 (Ramen Zundoya Dotonbori)
places.neighborhood: Sōemonchō 7-6, just east of Ebisubashi — 3 min from Namba Stn
places.cuisine: Himeji-born back-fat tonkotsu shoyu chain · motomi ramen ¥860, ajitama ¥980, all-toppings ¥1,360 · pick back-fat level (light to extra rich) and thin or curly noodles · table pickled ginger, garlic, takana · 24 h

noodles.notes: House-made ultra-thin straight noodles (2.00 mm), or curly noodles on request (2025–26).

ramen.signature_bowl: 元味らーめん (motomi ramen) — ¥860; 味玉らーめん ¥980 (October 2025).
ramen.chashu: Pork-belly chashu, thick and tender on the all-toppings bowl.
ramen.pantheon: Himeji's answer to Hakata on Dotonbori's east side: a pork-bone soy broth whose back fat you set yourself, ultra-thin house noodles, and a table of ginger, garlic and takana, all night.

richness: "A rich pork bone-based soy sauce broth with added back fat."
oiliness: "The broth is rich and fatty, yet not overwhelming"; back fat chosen from four levels (https://tabelog.com/en/osaka/A2701/A270202/27152648/dtlrvwlst/B516387909/).
clarity: "A slightly creamy soy sauce soup with added back fat" — an opaque pork-bone broth.
tare_strength: "The moderate soy sauce seasoning enhances the richness of the pork broth."
noodle_firmness: "The firm noodles pair perfectly"; "ultra-thin straight noodles, measuring 2.00mm" (https://tabelog.com/en/osaka/A2701/A270202/27152648/dtlrvwlst/B516309315/).
aroma_punch: "There was a hint of sweetness, possibly influenced by Banshu ramen"; table garlic, chili oil and takana let you add punch (https://tabelog.com/en/osaka/A2701/A270202/27152648/dtlrvwlst/B516327758/).

places.address_ja: 大阪府大阪市中央区宗右衛門町7-6

places.name: 大阪王将 道頓堀本店 (Osaka Ohsho Dotonbori Honten)
places.neighborhood: Dotonbori 1-chōme (1-6-13), on the canal — 10 min from Namba Stn
places.cuisine: Osaka Ohsho chain’s Dotonbori main shop · juicy gyoza · gyoza sets with fried rice or kara-age · hoikoro, mapo tofu, green-pepper beef · lu-su fried rice · 189 seats, upstairs river views
places.address_ja: 〒542-0071 大阪府大阪市中央区道頓堀1-6-13

places.name: 一蘭 なんば御堂筋店 (Ichiran Namba Midosuji)
places.neighborhood: Shinsaibashisuji 2-4-2, Gurukasu City Bldg 2F — 3 min from Namba Stn exit 14
places.cuisine: Ichiran’s "100% no tonkotsu" branch · creamy beef-bone and chicken broth with the red secret sauce · beef "gyūyarō" instead of pork chashu · order sheet for firmness and richness · booth counters · ¥1,280

noodles.notes: Firmness chosen on the order sheet (one diner chose firm, usually extra hard) (December 2025).

ramen.signature_bowl: とんこつ不使用100%ラーメン (100% pork-free ramen) — ¥1,280 (July 2026).
ramen.chashu: No pork chashu: sweet-spicy seasoned beef ("gyūyarō") instead.

vegan.note: Beef-bone and chicken broth; beef topping.

ramen.pantheon: Ichiran for people who can't eat pork: the booths, the order sheet and the red secret sauce over a creamy broth rebuilt from beef bones and chicken, with sweet-spicy beef where the chashu would be.

richness: "The flavor was surprisingly rich and creamy."
oiliness: No source mentions oil directly; placed mid-scale from the "astonishing creaminess and smoothness reminiscent of tonkotsu".
clarity: "An astonishing creaminess and smoothness reminiscent of tonkotsu" — an opaque broth.
tare_strength: "The unique 'red secret sauce' was perfectly balanced."
noodle_firmness: Firmness is chosen on the order sheet: "while I usually go for extra hard noodles, this time I opted for firm."
aroma_punch: "I felt it lacked the punch that real tonkotsu ramen offers"; garlic can be added (https://tabelog.com/en/osaka/A2701/A270201/27112600/dtlrvwlst/B429355331/).

places.address_ja: 大阪府大阪市中央区心斎橋筋2-4-2 グルカスシティビル 2F

places.name: 金龍ラーメン 御堂筋店 (Kinryu Ramen Midosuji)
places.neighborhood: Namba 1-7-12, on Midōsuji under the big dragon sign — 3 min from Namba Stn
places.cuisine: Kinryū’s yatai-style standing branch on Midōsuji · light tonkotsu ramen ¥900 · free kimchi, garlic and garlic chives · open kitchen, pavement-side tables · 24 h · smoking allowed

noodles.notes: "The noodles, which absorbed the flavorful soup, were delicious" (October 2026); thickness not described.

ramen.pantheon: Kinryū at its most street-food: a ticket, a standing counter on Midōsuji and a light pork-bone bowl that smells stronger than it tastes until the free kimchi and garlic chives go in.

richness: "The tonkotsu-based broth is lighter than it looks"; "I didn’t really taste the rich pork flavor" (https://tabelog.com/en/osaka/A2701/A270202/27005074/dtlrvwlst/B535411051/).
oiliness: "The rich yet refreshing broth was perfect for a late-night meal."
clarity: A tonkotsu-based broth "lighter than it looks"; no source says it is clear.
tare_strength: "The base ramen is quite ordinary… this simple flavor is hard to find these days."
noodle_firmness: "The noodles, which absorbed the flavorful soup, were delicious"; firmness not described, placed mid-scale.
aroma_punch: "The strong aroma of the tonkotsu (pork bone) broth"; garlic and kimchi "served in generous portions".

places.address_ja: 大阪府大阪市中央区難波1-7-12
